On September 10th, the grand celebration of the 3rd
Anniversary of Top Heroes is about to begin!

✅Conditions to participate:Castle Level 7 or above
✅Event Time:10th September~19th September
✅Opening Server:10001-10900
🎁 Gift Code:
TH3YRS
✅Valid Until: Sep 19, 2026
✅For more event details please click:

*Some servers will have early access on 9th
September.

Looking back over the past three years, we’ve grown
from humble beginnings to remarkable achievements,
witnessing countless thrilling moments along the way.
More importantly, we’ve been blessed with the
unwavering support and love of our players. To
express our heartfelt gratitude, we’ve prepared
exciting surprises and exclusive 3rd-anniversary
rewards just for you!

Three years mark a milestone, but they also signify a
new beginning. On this special day, let’s relive the
moments of glory and look forward to the endless
possibilities that lie ahead. The legend of Top Heroes
will continue to be written by all of us, together!

Three years together. Thank you to every Lord who

adventure we’ve shared, you’ve made this journey
truly special. ✨

Today, we’ve put together a special 3rd Anniversary
Video to celebrate these unforgettable moments. 🎬
Come watch it and relive our journey together!
And we’d love to share this special moment with even
more Lords.
 
🎁 Reach 2,026 total shares across all platforms to
unlock a special title for all Lords!
👀 And wait… did you notice there might be 2
mysterious gift codes hidden in the Video? Can you
find them?

Three years down, and the story continues.
Thank you for being part of our journey. Here’s to
many more adventures together! ❤️
